titles.a: Arsenal Have The Fewest Goals In The Top Six. Can They Keep Winning 1-0?
titles.b: Arsenal Are 6 Points Clear Before Man City. Will 1-0 Be Enough?

intro: After 11 Premier League games Arsenal have 28 points, six clear of Brighton and Manchester City on 22. This video goes through the table, the best defence and the lowest goals scored of the top six, the six one-goal wins, the win at Anfield, the defeat at Brighton, the draw at Newcastle, last season's title and Manchester City's recent form, using only what the cited pages say. No expected-goals figures are used because none could be verified.
disclaimer: Figures are from Wikipedia's 2026-27 Premier League table as of 27 November 2026, Arsenal's results on footballwebpages.co.uk, The Daily Cannon (1 November 2026) and Khelnow's Arsenal v Manchester City preview. The video does not predict the match or the title. Match clips are official club highlights (Arsenal, Everton, Brighton), short, muted and used with commentary; the owner and the match are named on screen. Photos are from Wikimedia Commons under Creative Commons licences, credited in this description.
